items.question: What can I do with Islamful each day?
items.answer: Check your prayer timetable, read or listen to the Quran, return to a saved verse, follow morning and evening adhkar, find the Qibla and check the Islamic date. Zakat and other tools are also available when you need them.

items.question: Do I need an account or an app?
items.answer: No. These tools are free to use in your browser without an account. Bookmark the homepage to return to your daily tools.

items.question: Where are my city and reading progress saved?
items.answer: Your selected homepage city, Quran place and adhkar counts are stored locally in this browser when storage is available. They are shared between the English and Arabic versions on the same site, but do not sync between devices. Clearing browser data removes them.

items.question: How should I choose prayer times?
items.answer: Choose your city and the calculation method approved by your local mosque. Times are calculated prayer start times, not congregation times. Fajr and Isha can differ between methods, especially at high latitudes. Check the displayed date when an update fails.

items.question: Why can the Islamic date differ locally?
items.answer: The calendar uses your selected calculation method and day adjustment. Local moon-sighting decisions can differ. On this homepage the time zone follows your selected prayer city, then your saved calendar setting, then your device. The date after Maghrib is shown separately.

items.question: What do the adhkar progress counts mean?
items.answer: They count cards you explicitly marked complete for the device’s local day. Morning and evening progress are separate. Counts do not confirm that a prayer was performed or that worship was accepted.
